name: codex-taskboard
description: Local-first issue board that runs in a browser and can be embedded in Codex as a sidebar panel. Installs the manage-taskboard skill so Codex agents can claim, execute, and track issues with taskctl.

interface.shortDescription: Issue board with agent claiming and execution
interface.longDescription: Codex Taskboard is a local-first issue board that runs in a browser and can be embedded in Codex as a sidebar panel. The bundled manage-taskboard skill teaches Codex to use the taskctl CLI to create, claim, execute, verify, and close issues. Launch the panel with the 启动 action (npm run codex) or scripts/start-taskboard.
defaultPrompt: Open the Taskboard and show me the current issues
Use taskctl to list my open tasks and claim the next one
Create a task for this request on the Taskboard
